base_branch_rationale: Storage has no open batch branch; wave A branches from main and later waves branch from the wave before them.

owner_start_signal.detail: The owner set the goal to implement the whole cluster plan in batch order; this record bounds Batch 3 wave A.

implementation_scope.summary: Versioned structure roles as table-less contracts, bindings per schema and scope, a conformance report that names every missing field and relation, the five starter roles installed idempotently, and five declared operations registered through the core operation registry.

forbidden_files_note: OperationDescriptor and SyncOperationRuntime are forbidden on purpose: the freeze enforces the v2 policy at registration precisely so that neither has to change.
forbidden_behavior: changing the existing schema, record or version tables in any way
changing the workbench: the optional localized field key belongs to wave C
adding role-specific business code: a role adds validation, listing and explanation and nothing else
editing an existing role row on a starter-role re-run; a changed starter role is a new role_version
adding a public HTTP, REST or MCP surface
changing larena/core, larena/access or any package other than larena/storage
touching larena.test or any live environment
push, release or deployment without a separate owner request
test_plan: Plain-PHP package tests in the existing storage style with an in-memory SQLite capsule mirroring the frozen shapes.
required_tests: a role is registered, listed and explained, and a second registration of the same code and version is rejected
a conforming schema binds, and the binding is unique per role, schema and scope
conformance names every missing required field, every type mismatch with both types, every missing required relation and a lifecycle mismatch
a publishable role rejects a schema whose lifecycle is not publishable
a conforming schema with extra fields still conforms: a role is a floor, not a ceiling
binding a non-conforming schema writes no row
an unknown scope and an unknown role each fail closed with their own reason code
the five starter roles install idempotently and a re-run edits nothing
the five declared operations load from operations.yaml and register against the core registry with no descriptor mismatch
smoke_plan: Migration parity on sqlite and mysql with restart readback of the registered roles and bindings, plus the core:operations:coverage report showing the storage role codes as covered.

action_gate_summary.note: Re-run the action gate inside the core package repository at coding start.

stop_conditions: a frozen table shape, identity grammar, state set or reason code would have to change
an existing schema, record or version table would have to change
the workbench would have to change
a recursive CTE or a MySQL 8 only feature would be required
a file outside the allowed boundary would have to change
an unrecorded product or architecture decision is required
the storage package repository is dirty or not initialized
nonclaims: A launch record authorizes a bounded coding wave; it does not authorize push, release or deployment.
Wave A ships roles and bindings only. A role-bound site tree needs waves B, C and D as well.
Registering the storage operations closes 9 of the 23 access operation codes the Batch 3 coverage report reported as unscheduled; the rest stay open.
